projectDescription: FirstFifty is a launch platform for indie makers that connects them with early adopters through tiered community access, devlogs, and an optional token launch on Monad with anti-rug mechanics built in.
keyFeatures: Founding 50 & Early 500 tiered access slots per app
Built-in devlog with per-tier visibility controls
Contribution Points (CP) system for early adopters
Open bonding curve token launch on Monad (optional)
Founder allocation vesting with contract-enforced anti-rug
Liquidity locked at graduation — enforced, not promised
Retroactive token allocation for early backers
App discovery feed with category filters
Leaderboards: Most Backers, Top Believers, Trending, Closest to Graduation
publicApiSurface: POST /signup — create account (email/password or Google OAuth)
POST /dashboard/apps/new — create a new app listing (authenticated)
Launchpad mint config: chain, mechanic, founder_allocation, founder_vesting, liquidity_lock_at_graduation, no_token_option
